status: three paired M1 Max/Metal offscreen routes complete; not a platform or visual promotion decision

comparison.method: three alternating pairs; exhaustive evaluation baseline versus 16x16 tiled candidate
comparison.interpretation: Full-frame work is effectively unchanged within the observed run spread, but tiled GPU render is consistently 1.42 ms higher and the tile-list build is about 1.40 ms. Overflow fallback preserves the exhaustive behavior, but this stress workload does not show a whole-frame benefit from tiling. Keep the 16x16 implementation selectable; do not claim a stress-route speedup. GPU pass intervals can overlap, so stage values are not summed.

limitations: This was an offscreen serial benchmark; native presentation and vsync are excluded.
The scene is an intentionally oversized diagnostic and does not establish normal gameplay performance or motion quality.
No route image checkpoints were captured in this run; byte-identical fixed-tick parity is documented separately in measurements-o03-overflow.json.
Only M1 Max/Metal was measured. The 8x8 tile-size candidate was not included in this sustained run.
Exact queue latency is unavailable because GPU timestamps are not calibrated to the host clock.
